prespecification_note: Written and pinned before the time-course model has been built or run. The observed values below were all seen before this plan: the CC-5013-PK-001 group values (EMA 2013) were extracted on 31 October and used to check clearance in 2.0a and 2.1e; the Bridoux 2016 values were read on 4 November for the 2.1h check. So this is a consistency check within studies already used, not an independent or blind test, and the report says so.
question: Does a one-compartment time course built on the body map's own clearance reproduce the observed peak concentration and half-life in each kidney-function group, given volume and absorption fixed from the normal group?

model.structure: one compartment, first-order absorption, first-order elimination; linear
model.clearance: CL/F(CrCl) = total clearance of the 2.0a pathway model under the intact-nephron reading at that creatinine clearance (renal + non-renal), bioavailability taken as 1, exactly as the body map view computes it
model.volume: V/F fixed at the normal group's geometric mean Vz/F, EMA 2013 Table 3 (56 L), at every creatinine clearance (assumption: volume does not change with kidney function; Table 3 gives 50-60 L for normal to moderate and 40 L for severe)
model.absorption: ka solved so that the model's tmax equals the normal group's median tmax (EMA 2013 Table 3, 1.0 h) with ke = CL/F(110 mL/min) / V/F, the pathway model's calibration point; the faster of the two roots is taken (absorption faster than elimination); no lag time
model.routes: at every time, renal and non-renal elimination rates are CLr x C and CLnr x C, with CLr and CLnr from the same pathway model, so the cumulative urine and non-renal amounts end at the fraction excreted unchanged the map already shows
model.solution: closed form (Bateman); checked against a numerical integration (RK4, step 0.01 h) and mass balance

chen_2007_demographics.use: group mean measured creatinine clearance (Table I): normal 102.2, mild 64.6, moderate 39.1, severe 23.9 mL/min

pinned_inputs.bridoux_observed_note: Bridoux Table 2 Cmax and t1/2 are not in the pinned observed file (which holds AUC24 only); if used, they are added in a new versioned observed file with page and table, before the secondary comparison is computed.

primary.values: EMA 2013 Table 3 geometric means (geometric CV) of Cmax and terminal half-life for the mild, moderate and severe groups
primary.model_at: each group's mean measured creatinine clearance (Chen 2007 Table I)
primary.model_value: typical Cmax and terminal half-life of the one-compartment curve after 25 mg

endpoints.consistency_not_a_test: AUCinf per group (follows from the 2.0a clearance, already checked in 2.0a and 2.1e) and the normal group's Cmax and half-life (the calibration group) are reported, not classified.

secondary.study: Bridoux 2016 (myeloma, day 5 of label-adjusted daily or alternate-day dosing)
secondary.values: Table 2 geometric mean Cmax and t1/2 for mild, moderate and severe
secondary.model_at: each group's mean Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance (Table 1), used as the model's creatinine clearance (the pathway model was calibrated on measured clearance; this difference is recorded)
secondary.model_value: Cmax on day 5 of the group's regimen (superposition) and terminal half-life
secondary.note: Not blind: these values were seen on 4 November 2026. Reported with the same classification rule, labelled secondary.

endpoints.excluded: ESRD groups (no dialysis process in the model).

classification_rule.interval: 90% confidence interval of the observed geometric mean: GM x exp(+/- t(0.95, n-1) x s / sqrt(n)), with s = sqrt(ln(1 + CV^2)) from the reported geometric CV and the group's n
classification_rule.consistent: model typical value inside the interval

decision_rule.summary: The time course is shown on the body map with the classification of its band. Where Cmax or half-life is inconsistent in a band, the time-course panel carries that band's warning. Nothing about the clearance model, its scope or its evidence status changes because of this check; any change is a separate step for the platform owner.
decision_rule.if_numerical_checks_fail: The model is not shown and the failure is reported.

software_checks: closed form agrees with RK4 within 0.1% for concentrations from 0.25 to 48 h
amount in body + cumulative urine + cumulative non-renal = dose within 1e-9 relative, at every time
cumulative urine at 120 h / dose equals the pathway model's fraction excreted unchanged within 0.5%
tmax at the calibration point equals the normal group's median tmax within 0.01 h
known_limitations: Volume held constant across kidney function; the observed Vz/F is lower in the severe group (40 vs 56 L).

Typical value at the group's mean creatinine clearance, compared with a geometric mean of individuals; with clearance non-linear in creatinine clearance only through the pathway split, the difference is small but not zero.
Same study as the pathway model's calibration (primary) and as the 2.1h check (secondary): consistency, not validation.
One compartment: an early distribution phase, if present, is not represented.
